name: screencast
description: Stream Windows second screen to iPad over WiFi

scripts.list-displays:
node -e "const {listMonitors,checkVirtualDisplayDriver,getSetupGuide}=require('./src/display'); const m=listMonitors(); m.forEach(d=>console.log(`  [${d.index}] ${d.w}x${d.h} at (${d.x},${d.y})${d.primary?' PRIMARY':''} — ${d.name}`)); const v=checkVirtualDisplayDriver(); console.log(v?`
Virtual display driver: ${v}`:'
No virtual display driver detected.'); if(!v){const g=getSetupGuide();console.log('
Setup steps:');g.steps.forEach(s=>console.log(' •',s));}"
scripts.kill-port: powershell -NoProfile -Command "$c=Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 9001 -EA SilentlyContinue; if($c){Stop-Process -Id $c.OwningProcess -Force; Write-Host 'Stopped.'}else{Write-Host 'Nothing on port 9001.'}"
